tasks.commitBody:
Argo allowlisted http://localhost:3000 and https://dev.mvox.eu on the Spaces bucket — his conventions, and we adapt. Vite's default 5173 is what the bucket rejects, so the dev server pins to 3000.

The half that matters is strictPort: Vite's default when the chosen port is taken is to increment silently, so port 3000 alone could become 3001 and the developer would see a CORS error and go auditing the allowlist while the actual cause is that something else had the port. strictPort makes Vite refuse to start and name the port — a five-second diagnosis instead of an afternoon. The comment at the site records that 3000 is an external contract, not a preference.

Nothing else moves: build, preview and test ports are untouched, and no reference to the old default existed anywhere to update.

Closes #347

(*MVOX:Palestrina*)
